title: Marketing copy (api-updated)
description: The `data` block of a marketing_copy updated event as delivered on the api channel (webhook / API destination): the Gold master projected onto attributes whose x-channels includes 'api'. contentId.description: Content identifier — the natural key of the library, and the one path segment of the retrieval URL. Live-measured effectively unique at version 'C' (6,561,618 distinct across 6,561,622 rows, 2026-09-03).

marketingCopyTypeCode.description: Content type (60 distinct values at version 'C').

marketingCopyText.description: Short human-readable description of the copy.

marketingCopyContentText.description: The full marketing copy text (max 348,438 chars observed; avg 1,665). Null means nothing is published yet — the retrieval API answers 404 for such rows. Deliberately api-only: content never rides event or message feeds.
